band_detail.name: SANTOS BRAVOS (산토스 브라보스)
band_detail.bio: 5-member Latin American boy group under HYBE Latin America, also known as STBV. Members Drew, Alejandro, Gabi, Kauê and Kenneth were formed through the reality show Santos Bravos and debuted on Oct 21, 2025 with the first single "0%". Group name represents duality — saintly yet brave. Fandom DUAL. Official greeting: "Hello, we are Santos Bravos!"

members.name: Drew
members.archetype: the fire that starts it all
facts: Grew up in West Covina, California in a Mexican-American household
Began dancing at 15, trained and taught at The LAB in Los Angeles
Worked as backup dancer for Ciara, Karol G and BTS
Appeared in J-Hope & Becky G 'Chicken Noodle Soup', Nayeon 'ABCD', BTS 'ON', P1Harmony 'Do It Like This' MVs
Choreographer for IU 'Holssi' and Boys World 'Piña Colada'
Former member of Simon Fuller's pop group The Future X

members.name: Alejandro
members.archetype: the key: direction, balance, and alignment
facts: From Lima, Peru; older sister is an opera singer
Tennis champion at 13, chose music over tennis
Studied at Interlochen Arts Academy and USC Thornton School of Music
Released solo songs '¿Quien Es Ella?', 'Pringao', 'Mareas'
Acted in 'De Vuelta al Barrio' and Peruvian 'La Rosa de Guadalupe'
Nickname 'Alejandro Spoilerú' for giving spoilers

members.name: Gabi
members.archetype: the power axis: presence, magnetism, mystery
facts: Born in Miami into a Cuban family, grew up in San Juan, Puerto Rico
Began dancing at 10, appeared on Pequeños Gigantes USA at 11
Portrayed René Farrait in Amazon Prime show 'Súbete a Mi Moto' (Menudo biopic)
Shortest training period in the group
Mood maker of the group, nickname 'Shakiro' for Shakira impression
Dream collaboration is Bad Bunny

members.name: Kauê
members.birthPlace: São João de Meriti, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
members.archetype: the echo of the soul: translating feeling into sound
facts: From São João de Meriti, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
Began singing in church choir with family
Won The Voice Kids Brazil at 14, debuted as gospel singer with EP 'Promessa'
Released 2 full albums 'Acústico Vol. 1' & 'Acústico Vol. 2'
Long-time fan of BTS, musical inspiration Michael Jackson
Arranged harmonies for 2025 Christmas Special 'Una Navidad muy Brava'

members.name: Kenneth
members.archetype: the free heart: curious, spontaneous, unafraid to feel
facts: From Veracruz, Mexico, moved to Mexico City for acting school
Started entertainment career at 9 on Pequeños Gigantes
Child actor in 'Contigo Sí', 'El Precio de Amarte', 'La Rosa de Guadalupe'
Former member of youth group KRUSH! Pop Kids
Nicknames 'Fuegito' and 'Young Boy Kenneth'
Favorite singers Bruno Mars and Luis Miguel

news_list.title: SANTOS BRAVOS Drop 'BAD' From GOLDEN HOUR : Part.5!
news_list.excerpt: Latin-heat title track with Mona Lisa flashes and Cohiba flow. MV and lyrics inside.
body: SANTOS BRAVOS have officially released 'BAD', the title track from GOLDEN HOUR : Part.5, across official channels on Aug 19, 2026.
The track blends Latin-pop rhythm with SANTOS BRAVOS's signature performance energy, backed by a music video and lyric videos on SANTOS BRAVOS Official channels.
BAD arrives as part of the GOLDEN HOUR series, following the group's 2018 debut with Treasure EP.1: All to Zero under KQ Entertainment.
Streaming and download links are open now on all major platforms.
